none: PAS CAM-FAA3C9: Roman Coin :Incomplete nummus of Valens, SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ [...] VALEN[...]

An incomplete nummus of Valens, AD 364-367 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left with wreath. Mint is Aquileia. Obverse shows unclear diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...] VALEN[...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: A/ //SMAQ[A or P]. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.88g, diameter is 19.3mm.…
